HUD Live v23

One connected interface across two screens, without placing the clock behind the bezel.
The reactor and voice console stay on the Windows primary monitor. Diagnostics and history stay on a companion monitor. Backgrounds still cover the combined desktop. The layout follows physical screen coordinates and adapts when displays change.

Tray options:
- Span HUD across all monitors: one connected HUD or separate HUDs.
- Keep widgets clear of monitor bezels: enabled by default. Disable to restore the old centred spanning layout.
- HUD appearance > Interface style > J.A.R.V.I.S. reactor or S.H.I.E.L.D. operations. Selection is saved.

Both styles share local Whisper recognition, voice commands, AI conversations, transparency, performance controls and automatic Windows startup. The whole interface stays fixed while internal rings animate.
